content: TaskNotes (>=4.10.0, verified in 4.13.8 and 5.0.0-beta.5 source) exposes app.plugins.getPlugin('tasknotes').api (TaskNotesRuntimeApiV1, apiVersion 1, hasCapability). time namespace: start(path,{description},ctx), stop(path,ctx), active() -> ActiveTimeEntry[] {taskPath,task,entry,index}, task(path), summary({period}) (minute-granular). events.on('task.updated'|'task.deleted'|'time.started'|'time.stopped') wraps raw emitter 'task-updated'; time.* only emitted when originalTask present (not for manual frontmatter edits, which surface as task.created+task.updated). lifecycle: ready() resolves at end of onload, isReady() = initializationComplete, on('layout.ready'|'cache.changed'|'cache.rebuilt'|'settings.changed'|'unloading'). Multiple concurrent active timers allowed; TaskService.startTimeTracking throws if task already active; stop throws if none. Official companion tasknotes-workflows polls availability every 5s via registerInterval and re-registers lifecycle listeners.
